summary: The J. David Gladstone Institutes' Mission Bay headquarters at 1650 Owens Street: a six-story, roughly 200,000-sq-ft biomedical research building for this UCSF-affiliated independent nonprofit, dedicated in December 2004. A roughly 105,000-sq-ft, $160M expansion at the same address was announced in 2023 but is not confirmed complete.

milestones.text: The Gladstone Institute's new Mission Bay building, across Owens Street from the neighboring Building 23B parking structure, is reported 'now under construction' in a UC Regents budget item for that garage, which notes UCSF's agreement to accommodate the Institute with 240 parking spaces
Gladstone Institutes dedicate their new Mission Bay research building
A roughly 105,000-sq-ft, ~$160M expansion at 1650 Owens Street is announced; reported as planned, not confirmed complete

facts.value: UCSF-affiliated independent nonprofit biomedical research institute, named for founder J. David Gladstone

2026-09-21 pass: the November 2003 Regents item mentioning Gladstone as 'now under construction' is about a neighboring parking-garage project, not Gladstone's own budget or design approval -- it corroborates a construction-in-progress date but is not Gladstone's own Regents record (Gladstone is a UCSF-affiliated independent nonprofit, not a Regents capital project, so no Regents budget/design item for it was expected or searched for beyond this passing mention).
